keys.title: Keys
keys.range: Select every row up to this one
keys.edit: Edit the cell (or start typing; Enter saves, Esc leaves it)
keys.paste: Paste a column of values from a sheet

lab.title: List frame
lab.failed: Couldn't load the list. Nexus Factory didn't answer: try again.
lab.blockedReason: Blocked: unblock it before acting on it

tools.columnsLabel: Columns and saved views of this list
tools.standardHint: The list's own columns and rows; the filters stay as they are
tools.noViewsHint: Arrange the list, then Save view as…
tools.updateHint: It keeps what the list shows now

customise.title: Customise columns
customise.hint: Tick the columns to show, drag them into order; the padlock freezes a column at the left.

held.save: Saving views needs the right to save views
held.manage: Needs the right to manage views
held.change: Only its owner changes it (or someone with the right to manage views)

tools.linkNotShared: The view in this link is not shared with you, or was removed: the list shows as it is.

save.title: Save view
save.name: Name
save.onlyMeHint: It is in your menu only
save.roleHint: Everyone who holds the role finds it in their menu; only you change it
save.noRole: You hold no role to share it with
save.everyoneHint: It is in the menu of everyone who opens this list
save.defaultHint: The list opens on it for the role's holders (one per list and role)
save.keepsNoFilter: The list's rows as it shows them now, without a filter
save.keepsFilters_one: The list's filter and search as they are now ({count} term)
save.keepsFilters_other: The list's filters and search as they are now ({count} terms)
save.keepsColumns_one: Your columns: their order, the frozen ones, {count} hidden
save.keepsColumns_other: Your columns: their order, the frozen ones, {count} hidden
save.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the link and copy it

removeDialog.title: Remove the view “{name}”?
removeDialog.mine: It leaves your menu. The list itself does not change.
removeDialog.shared: It leaves your menu and the menus of the people it is shared with. The list itself does not change.

job.title: Exporting {title}
job.label: {title} · {format}
job.note: You can close this window: the export goes on. A long export is e-mailed to you with a link, and the file waits under Export › My recent exports for {days} days.
job.expiredBody: Export files are kept for {days} days, then deleted. Export the list again for a new file.

why.rightsChanged: Your rights changed after you asked: export the list again.
why.noRight: You no longer have the right to see or export this list: nothing was exported.
why.tooMany: This view has more than 50,000 rows: narrow it with a filter and export it again.
why.tooLarge: The file would be larger than 25 MB: narrow the view or show fewer columns, and export it again.
why.stopped: The export stopped before the end: export the list again.
why.other: The export could not be written: export the list again.
why.selected: None of the selected rows is in this view any more: export the view instead.

problem.nameTaken: There is already a view with this name on this list: choose another name.
problem.tooMany: You keep 50 views of this list already: remove one first.
problem.busy: You have 3 exports running: wait for one to finish.
problem.stale: Someone changed this view meanwhile: open the menu again and retry.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more (removed, or not shared with you).
problem.invalid: Check the name and who sees it.
problem.sharing: You may share a view only with a role you hold; everyone and a role's default need the right to manage views.
problem.offline: Nexus Factory didn't answer: try again.

held.shipped: Shipped orders keep their promised day and priority
held.noRight: Changing orders needs the right to manage them
held.ship: Shipping needs a shipment: open the order
held.ready: An order is ready only when its work orders are done

tools.freezeHint: It stays in view while the rows scroll sideways

edit.cellHint: Edit: F2, a double click or start typing; it saves by itself
edit.unknown: No answer from Nexus Factory: it may or may not be saved. Check the row, then retry.

problem.date: Not a day: type it as dd/mm/yyyy.

refusal.held: Not changed: in its present state this field stays as it is.
refusal.stale: Not changed: someone changed it since you saw it. Look again, then retry.
refusal.missing: Not changed: it is not there any more, or not in your sites.
refusal.forbidden: Not changed: you may not change it.
refusal.invalid: Not changed: its own rules refused this value.
refusal.failed: Not changed: something went wrong. Retry.

bulk.subtitle: Choose the fields to change: the next step shows old → new for each row before anything is saved.
bulk.emptyHint: Leave it empty to take the value away.
bulk.heldNoField: Choose a field to change first
bulk.heldNoTools: Editing many rows is not available here
bulk.summary: Nexus Factory only: each row is saved through its own change, with the version shown here. Nothing is sent outside.
bulk.unchanged_one: {count} row already has these values: it stays as it is.
bulk.unchanged_other: {count} rows already have these values: they stay as they are.

exportSelected.heldTooMany: Export up to {max} selected rows at once, or export the whole view from Export ▾

calendarMode.label: {list} by {date}
calendarMode.dayLabel: The rows of the day chosen
calendarMode.pick: Choose a day in the calendar to see its rows (arrows, then Enter).
calendarMode.readOnly: The {date} is changed from the row itself here.
